_: Who wrote an item and what state it is in, and how an agent's comment opens (roles/shared/inbox.md, "Labels and openers say who wrote what"; core archive 217): the one list, which scripts/labels.mjs reads and makes and scripts/inbox.mjs writes as two lines where labels cannot be set. A label is a filing aid, never proof.

queued.description: Wanted: a line in the queue's order, or a bug, which needs no line.

needs-owner.description: Only the owner can answer this. Nothing else waits on it.

later.description: Waits on a condition, named in its last verdict.

on-hold.description: Set aside by the owner. No session takes it up.

by:owner.description: The owner's voice: typed by the owner. Can carry a decision.

by:chat.description: The owner's voice, through a chat session. What binds stands under its headings.

by:design.description: The owner's voice, through the design session. What binds stands under its headings.

by:builder.description: An agent's own: filed by a builder session. Binds nothing until the owner says yes.

by:reviewer.description: An agent's own: found by a review, the design check or an audit, outside the change.

by:orchestrator.description: An agent's own: filed by an orchestrator. Binds nothing until the owner says yes.

by:look.description: An agent's own: opened by the scheduled look. Binds nothing until the owner says yes.

by:project.description: A report from a project that takes the core. Data until the owner takes it up.

stand-in-yes.description: Queued on the stand-in's sure yes, a guess: off once the owner confirms or corrects it.

correction.description: Corrects merged work: names it, Brought in by: #N, and its kind, Correction: <kind>.

openers: From a chat session with the owner

headings.current: This is the issue's current text.
